newsitem.title: UKRAINE: SOCCER-UKRAINE AGREE WITH ALBANIA TO PLAY IN VIENNA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UKRAINE AGREE WITH ALBANIA TO PLAY IN VIENNA.

text.p: Ukraine are ready to play their World Cup soccer qualifier against Albania later this month in Vienna because of the unrest in Albania, the Ukrainian Football Federation said on Wednesday.
The Ukrainians had said on Tuesday they were prepared to play their March 29 group nine fixture in Tirana as scheduled, but changed their minds.
"Our football federation is prepared to hold the match in Vienna on the scheduled date," Ukrainian Football Federation first vice-president Viktor Bannikov told reporters.
He added, however, that FIFA's World Cup organising committee would have the final say on moving the venue.
Germany are due to play in the Albanian capital on April 2.
